columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as a number (2026 = FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027); the order field for prior-year comparisons (offset -1).
columns.name: Fiscal Year Number

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the plan year, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027 (in progress, H1 closed 30-Sep-2026), FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026 (the latest complete year).
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: True for FY2026, the fiscal year containing the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 ("this fiscal year").
columns.name: Is Latest Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: The group's lead (relationship) legal entity, e.g. the entity holding the account plan.
columns.name: Lead Client

columns.comment: Group segment (most common segment of its APAC clients): Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Group relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic groups" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for groups headquartered in Japan (Japanese corporate groups) - "Japanese corporates" / "JC" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Group industry sector (most common sector of its APAC clients), e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Group industry subsector (most common subsector of its APAC clients), e.g. Automotive Parts, Shipping.
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Lead office of the group = coverage office of its lead entity, ISO-2 code (SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand).
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Group lead RM = current primary RM of the group's lead entity (fictional name).
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the group lead RM sits - "RMs in Singapore" means this.
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Worst (highest) internal rating grade 1-10 among the group's rated APAC clients today; null = no rated client.
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: Highest IFRS 9 stage (1-3) among the group's APAC clients today.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when at least one APAC client of the group is on the credit watchlist today.
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating (Low, Medium, High) of the group's lead entity today; null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Worst current early-warning band among the group's APAC clients (Red > Amber > Green); null = none scored.
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Plan product family: Corporate Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FX or Sustainable Finance.
columns.name: Product Family

columns.comment: Status of the group's account plan - Active (current year), Revised (reset mid-year) or Closed (past years); null without a plan.
columns.name: Plan Status

columns.comment: True when the group has an account plan for the fiscal year (any product family).
columns.name: Has Account Plan

columns.comment: True when the group's plan for the year was reset mid-year (e.g. Kinokawa Precision FY2026, revised 10-Jul-2026).
columns.name: Plan Revised Mid-Year

columns.comment: RM owning the group's account plan (fictional name); null for groups without a plan.
columns.name: Plan Owner RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) of the plan owner RM - "RMs in Singapore" means SG.
columns.name: Plan Owner RM Office

columns.comment: Competitor bank (fictional) with the largest share of the group's wallet for the family.
columns.name: Top Competitor Bank

columns.comment: Original full-year revenue target of the plan lines in USD, as approved at the start of the year.
columns.name: Revenue Target USD

columns.comment: Mid-year revised full-year target in USD (only lines that were revised; blank otherwise).
columns.name: Revised Target USD

columns.comment: Target in force in USD = the revised target where the line was revised mid-year, else the original target.
columns.name: Effective Target USD

columns.comment: Actual revenue year to date in USD (FY2026 = Apr-Sep 2026, H1; past years = full year), from the gold revenue fact; Supply Chain Finance uses the CRM-recorded actual.
columns.name: Revenue Actual YTD USD

columns.comment: Actual revenue year to date in USD on the families that have a plan target (the attainment numerator).
columns.name: Revenue Actual YTD on Plan USD

columns.comment: Revenue year to date / target in force (fraction: 0.40 = 40%). At H1 FY2026 about 50% is on track; below 40% is behind plan (dim_threshold PLAN_ATTAINMENT_LOW).
columns.name: Attainment %

columns.comment: Revenue year to date annualised in USD (FY2026 H1 x 2) - where the year lands at the current pace.
columns.name: Run-Rate Full-Year USD

columns.comment: Target in force minus the full-year run-rate on planned lines, USD (positive = shortfall expected).
columns.name: Gap to Target USD

columns.comment: Revenue in the same months one year earlier in USD (FY2026 - Apr-Sep 2025; past years - the prior full year).
columns.name: Revenue Prior YTD USD

columns.comment: Revenue year to date in USD on the lines that have a same-period prior-year figure (excludes FY2026 Supply Chain Finance, whose CRM actual has no H1 comparable) - the Revenue YoY numerator.
columns.name: Revenue YTD Comparable USD

columns.comment: Revenue year to date vs the same months one year earlier, like for like (fraction - 0.20 = +20%, -0.15 = -15%); FY2026 compares Apr-Sep 2026 with Apr-Sep 2025.
columns.name: Revenue YoY %

columns.comment: Estimated full-year bankable wallet in USD - the revenue the group pays all banks for the family.
columns.name: Estimated Wallet USD

columns.comment: SMBC revenue used by the wallet estimate, annualised in USD (FY2026 H1 x 2) - the share-of-wallet numerator.
columns.name: SMBC Wallet Revenue USD

columns.comment: SMBC share of the group's bankable wallet (fraction); low values = wallet held by other banks.
columns.name: Share of Wallet %

columns.comment: Account-plan initiatives for the groups, years and families selected (detail in gold.dim_account_plan_initiative).
columns.name: Initiatives Planned

columns.comment: Initiatives with status Completed.
columns.name: Initiatives Completed

columns.comment: Initiatives still open at 30-Sep-2026 (Not Started, In Progress, At Risk, Delayed).
columns.name: Initiatives Open

columns.comment: Open initiatives past their due date at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Initiatives Overdue

columns.comment: Client groups in the selection.
columns.name: Groups

columns.comment: Client groups that have an account plan for the fiscal year.
columns.name: Groups With Plan

columns.comment: Attainment below which a group is behind plan at H1 (dim_threshold PLAN_ATTAINMENT_LOW, 0.40 = 40%).
columns.name: Low Attainment Threshold %

comment: Account-plan progress of SMBC APAC client groups by fiscal year and product family, FY2023-FY2026 (USD): the plan's original revenue target and its mid-year revised target, actual revenue year to date (FY2026 = Apr-Sep 2026, H1; past years = full year), the full-year run-rate, the same period one year earlier (Revenue YoY), the bankable wallet and SMBC share of wallet, the top competitor bank and the plan's initiatives. Every group with revenue or a wallet estimate appears, with or without a plan (Has Account Plan). Amounts add up across groups and families within one fiscal year - filter one Fiscal Year; attainment and share of wallet are ratios of sums. Grain: one row per client group x fiscal year x product family (gold.fact_account_plan_annual).
